facts.fact: The crown order case is tied with a green silk ribbon, which Pepper the goat eats off the rider's saddle and then bites his hand. Muthu's reply is written open in plain ink and sealed with one bead of black wax pressed with the iron warden's disc; the grey stick is left untouched.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires the ribbon, the open letter and no grey wax

facts.fact: Rema's escort wore pale green stiff cotton cuffs buttoned to the knuckle with two pegs and turned the wrist inward to take a cup; Muthu counted them during their four days in his gate chamber, and an escort member said drunkenly that a palace surgeon pares the guards' wrists each season.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Muthu show Neela how the guards wear cuffs

facts.fact: The crown order is written in a clerk's round hand, the same hand as the household slip 'Say nothing, and your wife is kept' (F504). Muthu notices it while reading and says nothing; Neela does not yet connect it.
